name: x11-background-computer-use
description: Exact background capture and guarded same-session input for EWMH Xorg desktops.

interface.shortDescription: Background capture and guarded control for Xorg.
interface.longDescription: Extends Computer Use on local EWMH Xorg sessions with exact XComposite window capture, best-effort no-focus shortcuts, and an explicitly acknowledged, journaled focus/pointer lease for reliable XTEST input. Supports Xfce, Cinnamon, MATE, LXQt/Openbox, and legacy GNOME or KDE Xorg sessions when their window manager exposes EWMH.
defaultPrompt: Use my existing logged-in X11 app to complete this task.
Capture an exact unobscured screenshot of one of my real X11 windows.
Operate this Xorg app and restore my focus and pointer when finished.
